d.en: Why have friends if not to play Golf... With Your Friends! Nothing is out of bounds as you take on  courses filled with fast paced, exciting, simultaneous mini golf for up to 12 players!

Came for innocent golf with friends. Left with friend betrayal, my wife screaming at me, and my daughter finding a new gaming buddy.

Golf with your Friends quickly becomes Golf with your Enemies. Friends are not included. Warning: Friends not included i have no friends Bought game expected to play with friends, but sadly no friends :( Still fun with randoms tho very …
The developers keep changing the physics, making some courses near impossible to complete on par or under (looking at you candyland hole 9 and oasis hole 16). …
高尔夫正经 地图不正经 高尔夫改版，主要改的地图侧重趣味性，如游戏名字偏欢乐。几元入库是米毛病的，推荐。本体不能全成就，注意。好像只能游玩一局掉物回血，但是行情不怎么样；要是能放置掉物就更好了。联机人较少，直联ping差，这方面差评。 …
原价买的这个游戏，总的来说挺好玩的呀，我看很多人都说他垃圾，但是我觉得晚上自己一个人玩还挺开心的，这个游戏自己玩也很培养耐心，很好玩呀！适合现实生活中也喜欢运动类的人，很有意思，地图和现实的高尔夫不一样，非常好玩呀！
标准模式地图还行，在其他模式地图并未做出相应的调试来适配新模式，导致部分地图体感非常差。
